what: Offline composition of a Vesu Earn supply and an exact-share redeem, compiled against live mainnet pool state and walked. No prover, no fee, no broadcast.
method: A throwaway undeployed sender with one fabricated note in the SDK registry; channels opened by autoSetup/autoRegister against the real pool; helper address is a non-zero placeholder because ours is not deployed yet. The compiled ClientAction span is read back and asserted by earn-guards.ts.

redeem.unit: vToken SHARES (18 decimals) — NOT an underlying amount
redeem.note: This is the corrected exit. The published PRIVACY-0.14.3-RC.0 helper called Vesu withdraw(assets); the SDK README still shows an exit passing an underlying amount. The span above passes an exact share count.

negative.what: The same compiled supply span asserted against a review amount of 999999999.
negative.message: EarnSpanMismatch: the compiled withdrawal moves 50000000 and the review said 999999999

actionLayoutsConfirmed.source: reference/privacy/packages/privacy/src/actions.cairo, confirmed by the compiled spans above

stillUnproven: No Earn transaction has been proved, submitted or settled through the live privacy pool yet. The composition and the span guard are verified against live pool state; the PROVER has never been given an Earn action list.

The end-to-end path (pool proves -> pool invokes helper -> pool credits the open note) is verified in its parts — fork tests for the helper and the pull, Gate 1 for the composition — but not yet as one mainnet transaction.

forkTests.what: VesuEarn deployed onto a fork of mainnet at a pinned block and driven against the REAL Vesu vTokens — not a mock. Funded by impersonating a real USDC holder, exactly as the pool's phase-6 withdrawal funds it.
results: a_real_supply_returns_real_shares — PASS: shares returned equal the vault's own preview_deposit exactly
a_real_round_trip_returns_the_underlying — PASS: exact-share redeem returns preview_redeem exactly, never more than went in, every share burned
a_stranger_cannot_drive_the_real_market_either — PASS: ONLY_POOL holds against real contracts
the_real_pool_can_pull_what_the_helper_approved — PASS: the STRK20 pool address transfer_froms the approved shares out; nothing stranded
every_market_in_the_catalog_round_trips — PASS: all SEVEN markets supply and exact-share redeem, including Re7 USDC Frontier which holds nothing (the first-depositor path)
forkTests.whyThisMatters: The mock tests in test_vesu_earn.cairo prove the contract does what we believed Vesu's interface to be — a mock cannot disagree with the assumption it was written from. These tests prove it against Vesu itself.

verifiedOnChain.classAtAddress: matches the class built from contracts/src/vesu_earn.cairo
